body:
Desktop Review v2, stage 1 "GitHub slice and links" (Flow 517): the Pull requests and Issues boards group by GitHub data only, every card gets a Keryx work row, and sessions can be bound to a PR or Issue. Three review rounds are done and their findings fixed; owner choices and known gaps are listed below. Requirements: `docs/requirements/keryx-desktop-review-v2/` (PRD R1–R3, R5, R6, parts of R4 and R7; decisions D5, D6). Stage 0 was #1294. Current state and deviations: section "Состояние этапа 1" of `implementation-plan.md`.

## What changes

- **Pull requests board, GitHub only (R1, R2, D6).** Groupings "Status" (default: Draft · Waiting for review · Changes requested · Approved; Merged and Closed only when the state filter includes them) and "My role" (Requested from me · Mine · Others). Quick filters "Requested from me", "Mine", "CI failed" sit in the context row, so the stage 0 toolbar measurements still hold. The attention and "In review" lanes are gone; the reason line uses GitHub data only.
- **Keryx work row (R4 part, R7 part).** A fixed 24px row on every PR card and list row with Review (`Review · <state>` from `localReview`, no round or behind count), Flow (by `prUrl` or a bound session's `flow` flag) and Session slots (count, newest, menu with all and "New session"). An empty slot shows its labelled action. "Fix review comments" is stage 4.
- **Sessions bound to a Subject (R5).** `subject` `{kind, repo, number, url, repositoryId?}` in the session's `flags.json`, written through `_keryx/session_flags` under a per-session `flags.json.lock` (the ACP server waits for it without blocking other sessions; a write to a session already moved to the trash is refused and does not bring it back). "Open in session" reopens the newest bound session or creates and binds one, prefilling the PR URL without sending. The session header links to the PR or Issue and its Flow. Issue sessions get `subject` from `withIssueBinding`; sessions an older keryx bound without one are backfilled on the next open unless the person unlinked it, and after the first bind a failed backfill no longer stops the issue from opening.
- **Older keryx.** keryx stores a new session only after its first turn, so the notice "binding was not saved" appears after that turn at the latest; the session keeps working.
- **Work from a bound session (R6).** `/review` with no target preselects the bound PR. "Create Flow" opens the bound session with a prefilled flow prompt. When exactly one new flow package appears within 15 minutes while exactly one request with a filled prompt is pending, the PR work row asks "Link Flow #N · <title>?" with Link and Dismiss. Only Link writes the session's `flow` flag; the offer stays until that write succeeds and shows why it failed. Dismiss, several new packages or several pending requests link nothing (AC9 as re-frozen in round 2).
- **Issues (R3, D5).** Default source "Project repository" (`keryx issues list` with `source: "repository"`, `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`, pull requests dropped, up to 3 pages per load); a stored choice wins, and the choice is stored per project and account. Lanes Open · Closed by GitHub state. The Flow stage filter is gone; the work row has Flow and Session slots ("Open in session"). If the repository source is unavailable (no GitHub.com remote, a remote that names no usable repository, Issues turned off → 410, or an older keryx), the board shows the reason and "Show issues assigned to me", plus an update hint for an older keryx; any other error keeps Retry.
- **PR header link.** A header link to a PR in a repository the board lists selects that repository. A link the board cannot show (another repository it does not list, or a PR missing from the loaded list, e.g. filtered out by state) shows a notice and is cleared, so nothing opens later on its own.

No Rust changes. User docs: `docs/docs/guides/desktop-issues.md`, `docs/docs/cli-reference.md` (`issues`, and `_keryx/session_flags` in the ACP section).

## Verification

At head (after fix round 3):

- `cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit`: clean. `bun test src`: 1070 pass, 0 fail.
- Root `bunx tsc --noEmit -p .`: clean. Root suites for the touched backend (`src/session/organize`, `src/acp/shell-session-organize`, `src/session/issues`, `src/integrations/issues-board`, `src/integrations/issues-launch`, `src/commands/issues`, `src/lib/file-lock`, `src/commands/acp`): 94 pass, 0 fail. `bun test src/acp`: 455 pass, 0 fail.
- Round 3 recorded runs (review package `research-evidence/`): the round's root and Desktop suites, and the verifier's repros of the three majors. Each fix in round 3 has a test that fails with the fix reverted (32 Desktop and 14 keryx checks, listed in the Flow 517 journal). The flags-lock tests no longer depend on elapsed time.
- The scenario "PR without Flow and review → Open in session → `/review` → review link on the card" is an App-level test.
- Stage 0 attention set: no line edited in any fix round.

Not verified: no run in the real app with real GitHub data; work row in narrow lanes, session menu placement, list width (1000px) and the LY-002/LY-004/LY-005 widths not measured; lint and the Rust CI path not run locally.

## Review

- Round 1 (head 6a2a3031f): 32 findings (2 blocker, 6 major); fixed in a34d8961b.
- Round 2 (head 88e3faba9): 44 findings (1 blocker, 3 major); HL-001 decided by the owner (confirmed link instead of a silent one); fixed in 80ef58bd5 and c4e8e3e24.
- Round 3 (head d7b0f7058, the round-2 fix range): 33 findings (0 blocker, 3 major, all confirmed by execution); fixed in 055115a20.
- Packages: `.metaproject/reviews/2026-11-23-review-flow-github-com-mrciphersmith-keryx-pull-1300`, `…-pull-1300-r02` and `.metaproject/reviews/2026-11-24-review-flow-github-com-mrciphersmith-keryx-pull-1300`. Decisions: the Flow 517 journal.

## Choices for the owner

Taken by the orchestrator during the fix rounds; each can be reverted:

- Create Flow waits 15 minutes from the press, not "until the next turn".
- A shown "Link Flow #N?" does not expire; Dismiss also stops offering that package. A failed Link is not retried after the turn; it waits for another press.
- A session switch while "Open in session" runs leaves no prompt and no pending request; a repeat press during an open reuses it without a prompt.
- New PR sessions also count a Flow found through a bound session; the launch dialog preselects the newest of several Flows.
- Review progress shows only in the slot title; the "Transcript updated" stamp left the card.
- A header link to a PR in a repository the board lists selects that repository; one the board cannot show gets a notice and is cleared.
- Warn tone for "needs answer" and "publication pending"; a merged PR keeps the "publication pending" text without the warn tone.
- "Show issues assigned to me" appears whenever the repository source is unavailable for one of the named reasons, chosen or not, and stores Assigned to me for this project only.
- Issues load up to 3 GitHub pages when a page holds only pull requests.
- A flags write waits up to 3 s for the lock, then fails with "retry".
- Subject backfill can re-link once a session unlinked before this version (no unlink marker then).
- In a very narrow lane the Flow slot clips the offer's Dismiss instead of overlapping the Session slot.
- Earlier UI choices: review slot state words; disabled "Run review" on merged or closed PRs; session menu button "More"; "not saved yet" for an unsaved session; "Create Flow" replaces the composer draft; Issue card buttons became work-row links.

## Known gaps

- Deviation (a), team review requests for the tab indicator, stays open; (b) is unchanged until stage 2.
- An Issue has no "another or new session" choice: the binding backend keeps one session per issue and account.
- A Flow created outside the Create Flow window, or with two or more requests pending, is not offered; it shows on the PR once it has a `prUrl`.
- `subject` names no GitHub account, so issue sessions bound under different accounts count together. GitHub Enterprise issues get no `subject`.
- A keryx older than this version drops `subject` and the unlink marker when it rewrites `flags.json`, so the next Issues open can re-link a subject the person unlinked (LG-014).
- Deferred info findings:
  - round 1 package: AR-002, PF-002, LG-004, LY-002/LY-004, UX-003..005;
  - round 2 package: PF-006/HW2-002, AR-004..006, HL-003, LG-014, LG-016, UX-006;
  - round 3 package: HL3-003, HL3-004, LG-R3-003, UX-014, UX-016, and SC3-001 (a stale-lock takeover race in the shared `src/lib/file-lock.ts`, which predates this PR; a separate change).

Flow package: `.metaproject/flows/517-2026-11-23-desktop-review-v2-stage-1-github-slice-a/`. Still to do: the merge decision.
